rules.logic: ABIOC(AI-SOC-72 Valid-Account Reuse From Anomalous Endpoint Context) AND ABIOC(AI-SOC-72 Rapid Privilege Escalation After Valid-Account Compromise) AND XQL(AI-SOC-72 Exfiltration to Cloud Storage From Compromised Host), stitched across two declared causality edges: (1) a process_lineage pivot binding the interactive-shell initial access and the escalation burst to the SAME sshd->shell CGO via shared causality_actor_process_image_name + causality_id (the escalation is a lineage descendant of the reused-account shell, not a time-coincident cluster); and (2) an endpoint_network_stitch pivot joining the endpoint exfil process to its outbound NGFW session so the incident spans ENDPOINT + NDR. Joined on the same agent_hostname and actor_effective_username within a 4320-second (72-minute) breakout window, they fuse into a single identity-to-exfiltration incident_id. This is the one incident Cortex XSIAM AI narrates: the auto-generated summary must name valid-account initial access (T1078), the scripted privilege-escalation burst (T1059.001), and the cloud-storage exfiltration destination (T1567.002 with T1041 beacon) inside the same window the intrusion took.
rules.name: AI-SOC-72 Identity-to-Exfil Breakout Stitch (Narrative Source Incident)
